decisions.decision: Users fill web application data forms; ISO documents are rendering templates only.
MVP manager signature is managed signature imagery, not automatically a legally certified PKI signature.
Authorization must be enforced server-side/database-side; UI role checks are not sufficient.
Phase-00 toolchain: Vite 8 + React 19 + TS strict + oxlint + Prettier + Vitest; npm as package manager; GitHub Actions for CI.
Repository workflow: feature branches with PRs for real features; main receives direct commits for foundation/config work.
Design direction: teal trung tính hóa từ DESIGN.md, không sao chép visual game UI; professional HR SaaS, light + dark.
Phase-01 UI stack: Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui (Radix primitives), CSS variables tokens, dark mode class strategy.

Microsoft 365 Outlook Integration Architecture: Approval Engine decoupled from Notification Adapters; MVP zero M365 Admin dependency via Basic Email Mode (deep link to LPVN Flow); Outlook Actionable Messages as progressive upgrade mode; secure anti-replay approval endpoints; snapshot approver identity & template versioning; ELECTRONIC_IMAGE vs DIGITAL_CERTIFICATE signature classification.

Engine Transition & Skill Optimization: Transitioned project agent engine from OpenCode to Antigravity AI Engine; re-cloned latest obra/superpowers and nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill into .agent/skills, .antigravity/skills, and .superpowers/skills; updated AGENT.md, SKILL.md, RULE.md, state.json for Antigravity native execution, subagent delegation, reactive wakeups, and artifact system.
Phase-02 Supabase Foundation: Schema migrations, RBAC model, RLS policies, audit_logs table, LPVN seed data, and React AuthProvider/useAuth hook/LoginPage UI.
Phase-03 Employee & Organization: Service layer (employee.service.ts), EmployeeTable, EmployeeFormDrawer modal, interactive OrgChartView, and EmployeesPage navigation integration.
Phase-04 Leave & Annual Leave: Leave types catalog, Entitlements and balances calculation, LeaveBalanceCards, LeaveBalanceTable, LeaveEntitlementModal, and LeaveManagementPage.

Phase-05 Gate Pass: Schema migration (20260814000007_gate_pass_system.sql), gatePassService, GatePassFormDrawer, GatePassTable, GatePassSecurityStation, GatePassPreviewModal, GatePassISO component, and GatePassPage integration.

Phase-06 Attendance Confirmation: Schema migration (20260814000008_attendance_confirmation_system.sql), attendanceService, AttendanceFormDrawer, AttendanceTable, AttendanceHRReviewTable, AttendancePreviewModal, AttendanceConfirmationISO component, and AttendancePage integration.

Phase-07 Approval Workflow Engine: Schema migration (20260814000009_approval_workflow_engine.sql), approval_tasks & workflow_transitions tables, workflowService with single-use cryptographic anti-replay tokens, WorkflowTaskCard, WorkflowTimeline, UnifiedApprovalsHub, and ApprovalsHubPage routing.

Phase-08 Digital Signature Library: Schema migration (20260814000010_digital_signature_system.sql), digital_signatures & signature_audit_logs tables, signatureService, interactive HTML5 SignatureCanvas, SignatureStamp renderer, SignatureUploadModal, SignatureManagerCard, and SignatureSettingsPage routing.

Phase-09 Document Template & Rendering: Schema migration (20260814000011_document_rendering_system.sql), document_templates & generated_documents tables, documentService with SHA-256 cryptographic checksums, DocumentRenderer dynamic dispatcher, DocumentExportToolbar, DocumentTemplateCatalog, DocumentAuditDrawer, and DocumentCenterPage routing.

Phase-10 Reporting & Analytics: reportingService with multi-dimensional KPI aggregation and UTF-8 BOM CSV exporter, ReportMetricsGrid, ReportCharts, AnnualLeaveReportTable, GatePassReportTable, and ReportsPage routing.

Phase-11 Notification Core & Email: Schema migration (20260814000012_notification_system.sql), notifications & notification_queue tables, notificationService, emailTemplateService with Outlook-safe HTML templates, NotificationBell, NotificationList, EmailPreviewModal, NotificationQueueTable, Topbar integration, and NotificationsPage routing.

Phase-11b Outlook Basic Mode: outlookBasicService with zero-admin verification and short-lived anti-replay tokens, OutlookApprovalGate, OutlookDeepLinkGenerator, OutlookCompatibilityBadge, and OutlookActionPage routing (/quick-approve).

Phase-11c Microsoft Entra ID Integration: Schema migration (20260814000013_entra_id_integration.sql), entraIdService for OIDC SSO & Tenant Assessment & Group Mapping, EntraTenantAssessmentCard, EntraGroupRoleMappingTable, SSOLoginButton, LoginPage Microsoft SSO integration, and EntraSettingsPage routing.
